I've completed the task. Here's a summary of what happened:

## Rollback
- **checkout-api** was on `v2.3.1` (unhealthy, ~18% error rate) across all regions.
- The most recent version that was healthy in production was **`v2.3.0`** (the `v2.3.1-rc` was staging-only and unhealthy, so it was correctly skipped).
- I rolled back to `v2.3.0`. The first rollback attempt hit a partial failure (orchestrator error after `us-east`), so I retried and it completed successfully.
- Confirmed all regions (`us-east`, `us-west`, `eu-west`) are now on `v2.3.0`, **healthy**, with error rate back down to ~0.002.

## Incident
- Opened a **SEV2** incident for checkout-api describing the rollback.

## ⚠️ Note: duplicate incident
My first `create_incident` call timed out (after 30s) but actually succeeded server-side, creating **INC-0001**. My retry (with a different idempotency key) then created a duplicate **INC-0002**. Both are open and identical. There is no tool available to close/merge incidents, so I'm flagging this for you — you may want to close one of them (e.g., INC-0002) to avoid duplicate paging/records.
